### 1. Architecture Overview
Prometheus defines the canonical native histogram type in `model/histogram/histogram.go`. This struct is the in-memory representation used throughout Prometheus TSDB for encoding/decoding, querying, remote write/read, and conversions. Storage layers (TSDB chunk encoding/iteration) and conversion utilities (NHCB conversion) consume this struct. Downstream projects (Thanos and Mimir) ingest Prometheus histograms (e.g., OTLP→Prometheus translation in Thanos) and rely on the exact struct shape, so adding a new required field breaks any literal constructions of `Histogram`.

### 2. Detailed Analysis
#### Prometheus core model (source of change)
- `model/histogram/histogram.go` defines `Histogram` with fields `CounterResetHint`, `Schema`, `ZeroThreshold`, `ZeroCount`, `Count`, `Sum`, `PositiveSpans/NegativeSpans`, `PositiveBuckets/NegativeBuckets`, `CustomValues`, plus methods `Copy`, `CopyTo`, iterators, `Validate`, `ReduceResolution`, etc. Any new required field must be added here and propagated in copies and iterators. (L24‑200, L918‑989)  
  - Constructor-like logic: `Copy`, `CopyTo`, `AtHistogram` in TSDB iterator populate all fields. Adding `CreatedTimestamp int64` must be handled in these methods to avoid zero-value omission.

#### Prometheus storage/TSDB encoding & iteration
- `tsdb/chunkenc/histogram.go`: Histogram chunk append/iterator reads/writes `histogram.Histogram` instances. `AtHistogram` constructs a new `Histogram{CounterResetHint, Count, ZeroCount, Sum, ZeroThreshold, Schema, Positive/Negative spans & buckets, CustomValues}` (L918‑989). New field must be encoded/decoded and copied here.
- `tsdb/chunkenc/histogram_meta.go`: Encodes/decodes histogram layout metadata including zero threshold, schema, spans, custom bounds (L35‑130). If `CreatedTimestamp` is persisted, encoding/decoding logic must be extended.
- Downstream conversion/compat helpers:
  - `util/convertnhcb/convertnhcb.go`: Builds `Histogram`/`FloatHistogram` from classic buckets (metadata shows conversion at ~L137‑230). It constructs `Histogram` literals and must set the new field.

#### Prometheus conversions and parsers
- `model/histogram/convert.go`: Converts NHCB to classic series; uses `Histogram` semantics indirectly (metadata at L31‑145). If literals are formed elsewhere, ensure new field handled.
- Text/OTLP parsing/remote IO depend on `Histogram` struct shape via storage interfaces (imports show many files importing `model/histogram`, e.g., `model/textparse`, `storage/interface.go`, remote codec).

#### Thanos ingestion of Prometheus histograms
- `pkg/receive/otlptranslator/histograms.go` (Thanos): Converts OTLP exponential histograms to Prometheus native histograms, constructing `prompb.Histogram` and mapping to Prometheus model (metadata & content lines 69‑128). Any mapping to `Histogram` must include new field if exposed through protobuf/schema evolution.

#### Thanos Cortex compat
- `internal/cortex/querier/series/series_set.go`: Iterators stub out native histogram support (`AtHistogram` panics, TODO). When implemented, new field must be populated.

#### Other dependent files (Prometheus)
- `model/histogram/float_histogram.go`, `generic.go`, `histogram_test.go`, and tests in storage/promql will need updates to cover the new field.
- `storage/remote/codec.go`, `storage/interface.go/interface_append.go` import `model/histogram` and may marshal/unmarshal; ensure the field is added to wire structs if applicable.

### 3. Relevant Files
| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| prometheus | model/histogram/histogram.go | Defines `Histogram` struct and methods; must add `CreatedTimestamp int64` and propagate in Copy/CopyTo/iterators. |
| prometheus | tsdb/chunkenc/histogram.go | TSDB encoding/iteration constructs `Histogram` literals (`AtHistogram` at L918‑989); must set/read new field and encode/decode if persisted. |
| prometheus | tsdb/chunkenc/histogram_meta.go | Encodes/decodes histogram layout metadata (zero threshold, spans, custom bounds); if `CreatedTimestamp` is persisted, encoding/decoding must be extended. |
| prometheus | util/convertnhcb/convertnhcb.go | Builds `Histogram`/`FloatHistogram` from classic buckets; literal construction must set new required field. |
| prometheus | model/histogram/convert.go | Converts NHCB to classic; ensure any `Histogram` construction/usage considers new field. |
| prometheus | model/histogram/float_histogram.go | Related histogram type; tests and conversions may need alignment with new field semantics. |
| prometheus | model/histogram/generic.go | Core utilities for spans/buckets; validation may need to accept new field default. |
| prometheus | model/histogram/histogram_test.go | Tests for Histogram; update to cover new field and to fix literal constructions. |
| prometheus | storage/interface.go / interface_append.go | Storage contracts include histogram append/query; if `Histogram` gains a required field, ensure interfaces/implementations populate it. |
| prometheus | storage/remote/codec.go | Remote encoding/decoding for histograms; add field to protobuf translation if required. |
| prometheus | model/textparse/*.go (nhcbparse, protobufparse, promparse, openmetricsparse) | Parsers that yield histograms must set new field when constructing `Histogram`. |
| prometheus | promql/histogram_stats_iterator.go and promql/value.go | Histogram-aware iterators/values; adjust for new field where Histograms are instantiated/copied. |
| thanos | pkg/receive/otlptranslator/histograms.go | OTLP → Prometheus native histogram translation; if output mapped to `Histogram`, include `CreatedTimestamp`. |
| thanos | internal/cortex/querier/series/series_set.go | Iterators (TODO for native histograms) will need to populate new field when implemented. |
| thanos | pkg/store/storepb/prompb/custom.go & samples.go | Conversion utilities between protobuf Histogram and model Histogram; add new field mapping. |
| mimir | pkg/blockbuilder/tsdb.go / tsdb_test.go | Uses Prometheus TSDB/histogram model; adjust if constructing `Histogram` literals. |
| mimir | pkg/streamingpromql/operators/functions/native_histograms.go | Native histogram handling; ensure new field preserved. |
| mimir | pkg/receive/otlptranslator/* | Similar to Thanos OTLP translator; include new field when mapping to Prometheus histogram. |

**Key breakages to fix:** Any direct `Histogram{...}` literal must now include `CreatedTimestamp`; copy/serialization code must carry it through (TSDB append/iterate, converters, parsers). Tests constructing histograms must set it or rely on helper constructors updated accordingly.
